files.text: Attention. This valley is closed by order of the Quarantine Authority. Proceed to the south gate. Transport is provided. Take one bag for each person. Leave animals with water. Do not lock your door. Your property will be kept. You will return when the review is complete. Do not approach the machines. They are here to help. Report persons who remain to the gate. This message repeats.
